thread:
maya: taking over evening shift (oncall until 03:00 PST). quick summary: ongoing multi-alarm situation spanning eu-west and us-east.
- Primary: maya (me) — taking ownership now
- Secondary: liam (standing by)
- Active alerts: incident-bot -> kv-eviction-surge (eu-west), rate-spike-gen (us-east), embeddings-worker OOM (us-east-2)
- Customer impact: intermittent 502s and higher p99 latency for hosted generation in us-east; dedicated tenants XCorp & PayZen seeing degraded request rates. CS notified (sofia, see below).

aj: handing off — brief timeline: spike started ~20:03 UTC after a small batch of large-context traffic. I enabled route-level shedding for low-priority traffic at 20:18 UTC to reduce load. Also drained two worker nodes that showed repeated OOMs. We saw a small drop in errors but eviction rate stayed high in eu-west.

incident-bot: [ALERT] kv-eviction-rate cluster-eu-west: 5m=18% (>10%) :warning:

liam: I'll own eu-west KV mitigation. Plan: 1) increase eviction throttle on secondary replicas, 2) enable aggressive prefix caching for hot tenants, 3) capture memprof on victim hosts. Will run the changes with canary on two nodes first.

maya: actions I'm taking now (in order):
1) verify current autoscaler decisions in us-east — scaling events looked noisy.
2) start a temporary scale-up for generator primaries in us-east: 
```
# scale up generation primaries (us-east)
kubectl -n inference scale deployment gen-primaries --replicas=8 --context=us-east
```
3) apply route shedding for untrusted/low-priority routes (already applied by aj, re-check config)
4) kick off evictions tracing in eu-west (liam will run the deeper checks)

aj: note — I also flipped a quick patch to the batching config to reduce max batch size from 64->48 for the high-latency route. It reduced tail latency slightly. Keep an eye on throughput.

sofia: I'll prep customer comms for XCorp & PayZen. Draft to CS: summarize impact, mitigation steps, ETA for next update in 30m. Ping me if this becomes a full outage.

deploy-bot: deploy/1234 completed in us-east gen-primaries at 20:26 UTC :white_check_mark:

liam: running the eu-west canary for kv throttle now. command:
```
ssh ops@eu-west-01
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kvctl set-throttle --pool embeddings --threshold 0.8
```
Monitoring eviction rate.

incident-bot: [INFO] route-shed active: /v1/generate: low-priority flags applied by aj at 20:18 UTC

maya: monitoring notes:
- Current p99 for us-east generation: 420ms -> 610ms (before scale), now trending down to ~480ms after scale-up.
- 502s decreased from 7%->2.4% after route shed but still above baseline for two tenants.
- eu-west eviction still elevated; liam please escalate if canary doesn't show improvement in 10m.

liam: canary update: eviction -> 11% (was 18%). Good sign. I will roll throttle to remaining nodes in 2 phases. Plan to finish roll in ~12m.

maya: mitigation checklist & runbook pointers:
- KV evictions runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction
  - follow steps under "throttle and mem-trace"
- Rate-shedding runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-shed
- If control-plane errors appear (503 from orchestrator), escalate to eng-sre channel and start incident bridge.

aj: additional observation — a customer test harness spiked ~200 concurrent large-context requests from a reserved tenant (XCorp). CS reaching out to them to pause test. If they don't, we may need to throttle that tenant directly.

sofia: XCorp confirmed they were running a load test, paused now. I'll keep them on standby and update.

maya: ongoing items to pick up for the night:
- liam: finish eu-west throttle rollout + memprof collection (primary owner)
- aj: monitor generator primaries in us-east and watch for pod restarts from scale-up (owner)
- sofia: customer comms & ETA updates every 30m (owner)
- me (maya): overall coordinator, will watch for cross-region regressions and paging loops. If tail latency rises again, we'll revert batching patch.

liam: rolling to remaining nodes now. ETA ~10m.

incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-worker OOM us-east-2: 3 occurrences in 15m

maya: aj, please check the drained nodes logs and worker restart rates; if OOMs persist after scale, we may need to lift memlimits.

aj: looking now — a couple of pods show repeated oom_kill on the worker container. I've collected logs to /var/tmp/oom-logs-7832101234.tar.gz and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-ops/oom-logs/7832101234.tar.gz

sofia: CS update sent to XCorp & PayZen: "We mitigated the majority of errors; we're continuing rollouts and expect a further update in ~30m." They acknowledged.

liam: rollout complete. eu-west eviction down to 7% now. I'll leave the throttle at this level and start a gradual rollback if stable for 20m. Will push memprof artifacts once processed.

maya: good. wrap-up before I sign off to sleep? I'm on until 03:00 PST so will be the primary through the night. If anything spikes, page me. Quick notes for next handoff:
- leave keys to the SLO dashboards pinned in the channel
- status: customer impact reduced to minimal; continued monitoring in both regions
- unresolved: embeddings-worker OOMs — continue collection, may require a follow-up infra deploy to bump mem limits

aj: ack. thanks, handing off logs & notes.

sofia: thanks team. I'll post the CS thread link here once I have the ticket IDs.

incident-bot: [INFO] next automated update scheduled in 30m

maya: ending handoff message. I'll update thread with any new changes. :thumbsup:
